subject.title: Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count

question: Which plugin-facing compaction reporting contract should OpenClaw support for context engines that own compaction: an after-turn/maintenance notification callback, a returned metadata shape, or a status/stats query surface?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but fixing it changes the public context-engine/plugin lifecycle contract and should not be chosen by automation without owner intent.

options.title: Add a notification callback
options.body: Pass a narrow `notifyCompaction(count?)` callback in post-turn or maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

options.title: Return compaction metadata
options.body: Allow `afterTurn` or maintenance to return a small result object, accepting a broader signature and compatibility discussion for lifecycle hooks.

options.title: Query engine stats
options.body: Add an optional status/stats surface for rendering, but own the risk of a second source of truth beside session state.

recommendation.title: Add a notification callback
recommendation.body: Pass a narrow `notifyCompaction(count?)` callback in post-turn or maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the context-engine plugin API and transcript maintenance contract where this reporting surface would likely be defined.
